Message text

Hi, this is Harvest Outreach Center. [School] asked us to reach out about support for your child. Could you answer a few quick questions so we can call you? [link] · Reply STOP to opt out.
Link expires in 7 days. Reminder after 2 days if not opened.

Thank you for your request of October 28. The three items you asked for are below. All information is drawn from the member's record and from the request already submitted.

TDT adds licensed clinical oversight and three units of direct intervention per school day, which the IEP cannot provide3.

Call notes · T.N., 8 · Sentara peer-to-peer · Dec 9, 2:00 pm

Asked for 150 units · awarded 65 · one call only · the clinician makes the call; this page is what she has in front of her
PrintLog the outcome
Open with
"This is Jordan Perez, LPC, license and NPI on the request. I'm calling about an eight-year-old girl at an elementary school in Campbell County who was approved for 65 of the 150 units we requested."
Credentials first — they will ask. Say "this eight-year-old girl," not "the client."
The two criteria she meets, with dates
Relationships. Hitting or pushing peers 3× a week in the last 30 days (Oct 1, 3, 8, 10, 15, 17, 22, 24, 28), 5–10 minutes each, needing staff to separate her. 3 office referrals. Classes: 6, passing 3.
Interventions that have not worked. School counseling weekly since Sep 2025 — ongoing, no change. Outpatient Jan–May 2026, 11 sessions — ended by the provider as "not making progress."
Level of care
Risk of a more restrictive setting: the school raised an alternative placement at the Oct 14 IEP meeting. Without daily intervention she is likely to be moved.
What 65 units means
At 3 units a day, 65 units is 22 school days. They ran out Nov 24. Since then Harvest has kept seeing her unpaid. We are asking for the remaining 85 units through Feb 6.
Questions they usually ask · short answers
"Why can't the IEP handle this?"
The IEP gives her a behaviour plan and seating. It gives her no clinical staff at lunch and transitions, where 6 of the 9 incidents happened.
"Is she actively suicidal?"
That is not a criterion for TDT. She meets two of the three listed criteria and one level-of-care criterion.
"You can't be spending 5 hours a day."
Staff log start and stop times on their phones. October average: 5 h 12 min a day, including lunch and transitions. I can send the log.
"She's been in services a long time."
Since Feb 2026. Incidents fell from daily to 3× a week; the goal is 1× a week before step-down. Progress is the reason to continue, not to stop.

Before the call

Oct 27
Partial award: 65 of 150. Peer-to-peer requested by phone; 48 min on hold.
Oct 27
Sentara offered Dec 9, 2:00 pm. First available.
Nov 24
Units ran out. Service continued, unpaid.
Dec 8
Reminder: this is the one chance. A reschedule is another month.

After the call

Log the outcome: reviewer name, decision, units. If they say no, the remaining option is to discharge and send a new initial request — Psyflo has the monitoring plan drafted.
Log the outcome
Who makes the call
A clinician. Psyflo writes the notes and logs what happened; it does not join the call.
